metadata.title: WF-06 MiniMax-H3 generative video: Colab route + Monarch face plan

content: Bhai mujhe batao Jese yeh ha : [https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3) to isko ham google Collab par chalaye hamne pehle bhi pichli chat me Kam Kya ha yeh monarch wf 04 monarch face me to Aage batao agar isis Tarah se isko ham run Karke ai videos generate karwate next kevel
Cloned MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3 to /tmp/h3; audited README, requirements, checkpoint trees, prompt-writing skill; fetched platform API create/query docs and pricing page

Landed WF-06 style: 6 knowledge docs, validated Colab notebook (14 cells), stdlib CLI h3_client.py, example shot list, offline test suite (17 tests), provenance record; registered in styles/registry.json + studio/registry.json; AGENTS/README routing updated; studio validate 23 passed 0 errors; make test 42 OK

Colab is the API control room, not a GPU host: H3-Base needs ~100-128GB resident, free Colab is 16GB. Default route = hosted API (2K capable); local weights documented as 768P-only exception. Spend gate mandatory before any submit.

WF-06 MiniMax-H3 lab delivered: knowledge base (model facts, Colab runbook, prompting grammar, routes/cost, WF-04 face integration), runnable validated Colab notebook with cost gate + receipts, stdlib CLI, example shot list, offline tests, provenance; registries + manifest + routing docs updated
